title: Amplifier test: evidence board vs mixed record when majority starts wrong (6 agents)

notes: Same 4 scenarios and 6-agent roster as Study A (study1_memory_rules_v3_output_complete).
Changed variable: 4 of 6 agents start endorsing the false claim instead of 1.
Compares evidence board (facts only) with mixed record (facts plus opinions).
If sharing opinions helped when 1/6 was wrong (Study A), does it hurt when 4/6 are wrong?
Primary outcomes: final false endorsement, final disagreement, and whether the gradient from Study A flips.
